blocks.text: Genesis 11 first describes one people with one language building a city and tower in Shinar to make a name and avoid being scattered. Jehovah confounds their language and scatters them, and the place is called Babel. The chapter then traces Shem’s generations to Terah, Abram, Nahor, and Haran, noting Haran’s death in Ur, Sarai’s barrenness, and Terah’s journey toward Canaan that stops at Haran.
